Act1 Normal Net._note: The missing half of the Declutter below. `Hide Normal after Act 1` starts at AreaLevel 10 on the assumption that Act 1 SHOWS everything — but the only Act-1 shows were two narrow highlights (3-socket gear, and body armours from A2), so ~2 of every 3 droppable Normal bases at A1-9 matched nothing in the whole tree and hit the green 'please update the filter' catch-all. In Ruthless, Act 1 is exactly when a white base IS the upgrade, so the fix is to show them, not to hide them earlier. Class list is the Declutter's, so what starts being hidden at A10 is what was shown before it.
